transactions._note: Trade valuation and display. grade_bands are descending [adjusted share percent, label] pairs. blockbuster_min_multiple and blockbuster_min_headliner_share are inclusive ratios to the snapshot leader. proxy_pick_slot sets the K/DST proxy and swap anchor. surplus_swap_max_relative_error is the maximum fractional swap error. draft_slots_per_round is the field size. draft_tier_anchors is the early/mid/late pivot triplet on a 12-slot reference scale, rescaled for other field sizes. movement_types lists Sleeper transaction types counted in weekly adds/drops, excluding trades.

consolidation._note: asset-concentration discounts spread-out dynasty value only. Use none for raw dynasty grades. The rate is the fraction of the spread penalty applied (0–1). Contender always uses raw values until a separate rate is approved.

transactions.rebuild_grade_caps_note: Display-only Rebuild caps, first matching row wins. Each row is [exclusive upper percent of snapshot leader, lowest label, highest label], using the combined raw dynasty total including K/DST proxies. Omit a higher band to leave it uncapped. Use [] to disable. Even and unavailable are unchanged.

labels._note: Public headings and valuation labels. Plain text only.

fantasycalc._note: Public FantasyCalc request settings. dynasty, num_qbs, num_teams and ppr must match the scoring format. timeout_seconds sets the request timeout. minimum_player_rows prevents incomplete responses from overwriting snapshots.

team_fit._note: Historical Team Fit is separate from market price. Only verified archived pre-trade data is used. Scores describe a modeled goal, not observed manager intent.
team_fit._scale_note: meaningful_*_points set the size of one fit unit. score_points_per_unit converts one unit to score points around neutral 50.
team_fit._situation_note: record_weight blends win fraction with the existing contender index. Available odds from odds_first_week blend in at playoff_context_weight. An eligible bowl chance matters less than playoff odds via bowl_weight. win_now_ceiling preserves some future weight for contenders.
team_fit._rebuild_note: Below rebuild_max_weight treat picks as flexible capital with pick_flexibility as a proportional utility allowance, not a market price. Rebuild starter coverage adds rebuild_starter_weight of capped above-floor future starter capacity. With net new pick capital, don't assume lost starter capacity goes unfilled. Pre-deadline negative lineup impact fades from fully waived at rebuild_lineup_no_weight_at to fully counted at rebuild_lineup_full_weight_at, through the configured deadline week only.
team_fit._age_note: For each horizon, age_curves entries are [gradual onset age, annual gradual decline, steep onset age, annual steep decline]. Discount only newly elapsed time above each onset. Missing birth date leaves the market value flat, not guessed.
team_fit._specialist_note: Known K/DST without market prices use the historical proxy. Starting coverage uses specialist_lookback_weeks of prior scores, scaled to specialist_target_ppg. specialist_needs_points determines how much that scarce slot matters to fit. No future injury or starter data is used.
